full_judgment:
Mr. A. K. Badrul Huq, J.: Subject matter of challenge in this civil Revision petition under section 115 of the Code of Civil procedure (shortly the Code) is an order dated 29,5.2003 recorded by Joint District judge, first court,  Jhenaidah in Miscellaneous case No. 13 of 2003 rejecting a petition laid by judgment debtor petitioner for staying further proceeding of Decree Execution case no. 15 of 200117,:pending in the above court. 

 2. Plaintiff opposite party No. 1 obtained an exparte decree in Artha Rin Case No. 5 of 2000 in the Court of Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No. 1, Jhenaidah. Tile decree was put, to Execution in Decree Execution case No. 15 of 2001. 

 3. In the Execution case the property was put to auction and it was purchased by Opposite party no. 2 for Taka 3,02,0001-. 

 4. Judgment  debtor petitioner, thereafter, filed a petition under order XXI, rule 90 of the Code for setting aside the auction Sale. The petition has been numbered as Miscellaneous case No.13 of 2003. 

 5. Judgment debtor petitioner filed a petition in the court in Miscellaneous case No. 13 of 2003 praying for stay of further Proceeding of Decree Execution case No. 15 of 2001 till disposal of the Miscellaneous Case. 

 9. Judgment debtor petitioner, for setting aside the auction purchase by opposite party no. 2, .filed Miscellaneous case no. 13 of 2003. In the event of disposal of the Decree Execution case during pendency of Miscellaneous case laid under order XXI, rule 90 of the code legal complication may occur. In order to avoid that justice demands that Miscellaneous case No. 13 of 2003 be disposed of within a period fixed by this court and till disposal of the Miscellaneous case, further proceeding of Decree Execution case No. 15 of 2001 be stayed and, thus, appropriate direction be recorded, in the interest of justice the following directi6bns are Record. 

 A. Learned subordinate -Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Jhenaidah is directed to dispose of 'Miscellaneous case No.13 of 2003 within a period of two (2) months positively from date of receipt of this order. Learned Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Jhenaidah is also, directed to remove all procedural hurdles predicaments and technicalities in disposing of Miscellaneous case no. 13 of 2003. 

 B. Proceedings of Decree Execution case No.15 of 200, shall remain stayed till disposal of Miscellaneous case no. 13 of 2003.
